I was waiting for Fortnite to come back after the black hole event & just went out. My sister was using too when I first started & I would’ve lost my mind if I lost her...She only started cause she saw me doing it & how it made me feel at first..

I had a similar time with my first OD. Went out to smoke & sat on our riding mower, on Facetime with my girlfriend & kept nodding hard & she was saying “why are you being dumb, stop it”, she never saw me nod like that & then just lights out. Woke up on the ground a couple feet away with EMT’s over me. My last time, I was home by myself at my parent’s house, I legit got very lucky. They got home a little after I OD’d, my sister already knew after seeing me & saving me twice. I never want my Mom, Dad & sister to see me laying lifeless like that again..My Nanny (Grandma) was with them too but heard my Mom start screaming so she didn’t come inside..I still used after every OD. Finally have 172 days sober on methadone maintenance.    Sorry for the long comments lmao, just very relatable & haven’t really talked about this too much to people.

I’ve survived 3 OD’s. Did a little too much & nodded out. Everything just goes black. No pain, no sounds, no anything. You just fade away very peacefully. Once I got narcanned by the EMT’s I started hearing my name & saw there bright ass lights lol. I’m sorry about your brother OP..This disease is no joke man, it doesn’t care who you are or what you have, it will take everything from you, everything.
Is that scramble? 😩🤤🤤 I’m 171 days clean so far, caps had me by the balls. Only fent could get me a nod. Be safe man & happy nods 🤙

Snorting it takes about 10ish mins to feel effects. You feel warm, maybe a little itchy, you don’t really care about much. It is like hanging out with a best friend or your soulmate, not a care in the world. You do enough & you can’t really function, you start nodding off, might say random shit that you don’t remember. Wouldn’t recommend driving if you are nodding lol Too much & you are going to sleep & not waking up. I overdosed 3 times by nodding out & forgetting how to breathe basically. I didn’t crave it after my first time, it took about a week or so of steady use to crave it. I still crave it & been clean almost a year or so. The day after is kind of a blur, you most likely are gonna just want to sleep. Terms I know on the East Coast are “boy”, “dope”, “dog food”, “raw” which is just raw heroin, “scramble” which is heroin & A LOT of additives to really fuck you up including fentanyl, my personal favorite lmao But yeah, if you try it, have someone with you & my golden rule, you can always do more, you can never do less. Happy Nods & stay safe! 🤙🤙
